newsitem.title: SPAIN: Endesa privatisation will be expandable.
newsitem.headline: Endesa privatisation will be expandable.

text.p: The Spanish Energy Secretary said on Thursday that in the next phase of the privatisation of 66-percent state-owned Endesa the government is studying a 20 percent offer with an optional expansion to 33 percent.
The novel approach is due to the sheer size of the offer, he said.

"If one were to place 33 percent, we are talking of a volume of the order of one trillion pesetas, which would be the biggest placement in history," Energy Secretary Nemesio Fernandez Cuesta told journalists.
The only condition the Ministry has put on those designing the operation is that the state reduce its stake to less than 50 percent, he said.
"This puts the minimum placement at some 20 percent," Fernandez Cuesta said.
The final size of the offer will depend on demand levels in the autumn.
